text:
maya: ok random thought: if each open model we host were a roommate, who would leave dishes in the sink forever? 😂 poll time
priya: I nominate 'Caprica' — talks a lot, never cleans, but bakes great retrievals.
jon: Sherpa would be the one labeling everything in the fridge with timestamps. :face_with_monocle: 
sam: tiny-llm: lives under the bed, steals socks (aka tokens), apologizes in 3 tokens and leaves.
zoe: @maya make a poll! I'll vote for the one that hoards GPUs.
bot-echo: Poll created: 🗳️ Which model would be your chaotic roommate? Options: Caprica (loud), Sherpa (neat), Tiny-LLM (mystery), Redwood-Guest (occasionally helpful)
larry: Redwood-Guest shows up with baked ziti and a dashboard printout. Clean but opinions about quantization.
maya: also propose a roommate ground rule: No evals in the living room after 10pm. :zzz: 
priya: addendum: if they use the living room TV for a model speedrun, cleaning duty for a week.
sam: I will accept those terms as long as Tiny-LLM gets a tiny plant.
jon: :thumbsup: can we put this in #random culture doc? or just meme for posterity.
zoe: screenshotting. tagging @design for roommate sticker ideas :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
